set.voxels.show.help: Shows the walls as voxels: over the scan, or instead of it (the scan hidden, you fly on the voxels). V switches it; a reload shows the scan again.
set.voxels.style.help: How the voxels are drawn. Floating pieces of the walls stand out in every style; "Floaters in red" colours only them.
set.voxels.opacity.help: How solid the voxels look while the scan shows under them.
set.voxels.opacityOnly.help: How solid the voxels look with the scan hidden.
set.scene.walls.help: Off: the drone flies through everything, no crashes. Kept for each scan; the author may switch the walls of a noisy scan off by default. C switches it.
